title: Pins from generated 3.0.0.0 flow definitions versus v0.1.1 fixtures

create.reason: Local engine and generated create template write Version 1. Fixture pairs return Version 2. Amendment records the fixture mismatch; client does not invent Version 2.

readiness.reason: Local engine follows the ARB-lane generated branch (READY_FOR_ARB). Fixtures pair DECISION_READY with Lane PREPARATION, which is the other branch of the same generated expression. Both mismatches stay visible.

replay.contractSection: v0.1.1 §7a stored-response: preserve original Created, including true
replay.reason: Replay fixtures rewrite Created to false. Local client uses §7a.

partialResume.localEngine: refuses resume without Title/SourceChannel as a create-shaped request
partialResume.reason: Amendment proposes a versioned create-versus-resume discriminator. v0.1.1 is not silently extended.

rootOneOf.reason: Public root oneOf rejects two legitimate error pairs because GetWorkStatus and RequestDecisionReadiness overlap. Client validates by operation.

mockServer.reason: Shipped mock is not the acceptance simulator. Cached negatives become 200 and three replay bodies disagree. Local MemoryCommandTransport plus LocalCoreEngine replace it for Binding A tests.

packetProjection.reason: None of the five operations returns packet IDs, questions, assigned person, due date or current packet version. Local projection is marked an extension, not a sixth deployed op.
